events.name: Chobin Wants a Ride
events.intro: The very serious boy from the sketch stall is waiting by a rowboat with a hand-painted sign: CHOBIN DRIVES. "Chobin has never driven," he says, "but Chobin has a feeling you will need a boat."

success.text: He salutes. He has clearly practised the salute. Chobin will meet you at the water when the water matters.
"Chobin will wait," he says, and does not look disappointed at all.

events.name: A Girl Who Hears Hearts
events.intro: A girl sits very still beside the road with her hand an inch from a hurt Pokémon, not touching it. "Shh," she says to you, kindly. "It's telling me something." Her name is Rui.

success.text: Rui walks a little behind you, listening. When one of your Pokémon is hurt, she is already there.
"It said it's a little less afraid than it was." She smiles at your party. "So are they."
Rui nods and goes back to listening.

events.name: The Professor's Card Table
events.intro: A man in a rumpled coat has set up a card table by the road with a ring of small lights on it. Professor Krane. "It's not my best work," he says, looking at your Shadow Pokémon. "It's held together with tape. But it turns."

choices.label: Help him carry the Purify Chamber

success.text: He folds the table and hands you one end. "Waiting near something," he says. "That's most of science."

choices.label: Let him look at your Shadow Pokémon

success.text: He listens to the haze for a long moment and writes a number on a card. "Lighter, already."
He waves with the hand that is not holding a screwdriver.
